subtitulo: Creates the USB drive that boots straight into Ekfrase Writer.
disco.legenda: USB flash drives, SSDs and hard drives
disco.nenhum: No USB flash drive, SSD or external hard drive found. Plug one in and wait a moment: the list updates by itself.
disco.nunca-interno: This computer's own disk never shows up here.
recusa.sistema: Not allowed: it is one of this computer's disks (it holds the system).
recusa.gravador: Not allowed: the Drive Creator or the image is on this drive.
recusa.somente-leitura: Not allowed: the drive is write-protected (check for a small lock switch).
recusa.pequeno: Not allowed: it needs at least 4 GB.
recusa.setor: Not allowed: this drive's sector size is not supported.
recusa.em-uso: Not allowed: the drive is in use by encryption, LVM or RAID.
modo.legenda: This drive is already a Writer OS. What should we do?
modo.atualizar.texto: replaces only the system; your writing stays.
imagem.release: Writer OS {versao}: the Drive Creator downloads it ({tamanho}) and checks the Ekfrase seal.
imagem.sem-rede: No internet to download the image. Connect, or use "I already have the image".
imagem.sem-release: Writer OS has not been published yet. If you already have the image, use "I already have the image".
confirmar.apaga: Everything on this drive will be erased.
confirmar.so-writer: It is best to use a drive just for Writer. External hard drives often hold backups: check first.
confirmar.atualiza: Only the system is replaced. The EKFRASE-DADOS partition, with your writing, stays as it is.
confirmar.digite: To confirm, type the drive's name:
conteudo.usado.one: This drive has {usado} used in {count} partition: {rotulos}.
conteudo.usado.other: This drive has {usado} used in {count} partitions: {rotulos}.
espaco.legenda: Space for your writing (the EKFRASE-DADOS partition)
espaco.limitar: Limit it (to leave the rest of the drive free)
semlacre.titulo: This image does not have the Ekfrase seal.
semlacre.texto: It was not made by Ekfrase, or it was changed afterwards. Only continue if you built it yourself or trust whoever gave it to you.
gravando.nao-tire: Do not unplug the drive or close the Drive Creator until it finishes.
gravando.nao-feche: Wait until it finishes: closing now would leave the drive half done.
fase.conferir-imagem: Checking that the image arrived intact…
fase.permissao: Asking for permission to write to the drive…
fase.conferir: Checking the drive and the image…
fase.dados: Creating the partition for your writing…
erro.disco-mudou: The drive changed since it was chosen (another drive was plugged in or removed). Nothing was erased. Please choose again.
erro.disco-sumiu: The drive is no longer plugged in. Nothing was erased.
erro.recusado: This drive cannot be used (see the reason in the list). Nothing was erased.
erro.imagem-mudou: The image changed while writing. Please write it again.
erro.imagem-corrompida: The image is damaged (the file is incomplete or corrupted). Download it again.
erro.nao-e-writer-os: This is not a Writer OS image (or, for an update, the drive is not a Writer OS).
erro.lacre-invalido: The seal does not match: the image is not Ekfrase's or was changed. Do not write this image.
erro.sha-diferente: The image does not match its .sha256 file: it is damaged or was changed. Download it again.
erro.setor: This drive's sector size is not supported.
erro.pequeno: The drive is too small for Writer OS.
erro.nao-cabe: The new system does not fit in the drive's partition. Use "Start over".
erro.nao-fat32: The image does not have the expected file system.
erro.fat-incompativel: This image does not work on this drive (4 KB sectors).
erro.em-uso: The drive is in use. Close any files and windows open on it and try again.
erro.escrita: Could not write to the drive. Unplug it, plug it back in and try again (or use another USB port).
erro.verificacao: What was written does not match the image: the drive may be faulty. Try again or use another drive.
erro.formatar: The system was written, but the partition for your writing was not. It will be created on first boot.
erro.fora-da-faixa: The Drive Creator stopped for safety before writing outside the right place.
erro.sem-rede: The internet dropped and did not come back. Try again: the download resumes where it stopped.
erro.sem-release: Writer OS has not been published yet.
erro.cancelado: Cancelled. What was already downloaded is kept for next time.
erro.sem-espaco: Not enough space on this computer to download the image (about 700 MB).
erro.ocupado: The Drive Creator is already writing.
erro.confirmacao: The name typed is not the drive's name.
erro.sem-lacre: To write an image without the seal, type the phrase in the red warning.
erro.permissao-recusada: Without permission, the Drive Creator cannot write to the drive. Nothing was erased.
erro.sem-pkexec: This Linux has no pkexec (the administrator password prompt). Install polkit or run the Drive Creator with sudo.
pronto.titulo-criar: Done: the Writer drive is ready
pronto.texto: To use it: turn the computer off, leave the drive plugged in and turn it on while pressing the boot menu key (below). In the menu, pick the drive by its name.
pronto.dados-no-boot: The partition for your writing will be created by itself on first boot.
boot.titulo: How to boot from the drive
boot.lenovo.tecla: F12 right after turning on (on some, Fn+F12), or the Novo button: a pinhole on the side, pressed with the computer off.
boot.hp.tecla: Esc right after turning on, then F9 in the menu.
boot.acer.tecla: F12 right after turning on (if nothing opens, enable "F12 Boot Menu" in the setup, opened with F2).
boot.asus.tecla: Esc on laptops; F8 on desktops.
boot.samsung.tecla: F2 opens the setup; in the Boot tab, put the drive first.
boot.outra.tecla: try F12, Esc, F11 or F9 right after turning on. The boot menu shows the drive by name.
boot.secure: There is no need to turn Secure Boot off: Writer OS boots with it on.
ejetar.falhou: Could not eject. Close any windows open on the drive and try again.
